Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Create ONE standalone simplified brand emblem for the same original Daoist chibi game 「一符镇万妖」, using the attached accepted logo as the exact design and painted-material reference. The result is a square transparent PNG with NO lettering at all.
The emblem must derive from the single ivory paper talisman charm at the upper-left of image1: same warm-ivory parchment, dark-jade edge shading, small round jade-and-gold cap, braided jade loop, small ivory-and-jade ribbon tails and the ONE recognizable cinnabar flowing abstract flame/swirling mark on the paper. Keep that red flowing symbol as a simple broad pictogram, never a readable Chinese character. Make the talisman angled gently from upper-left toward lower-right, rounded and chunky. Simplify fine cords and tassel threads into a few confident larger painted forms so it works at64px. Add one compact jade/ivory ruyi-cloud crescent sweeping under and around the lower half, like the cloud swoosh in image1, with a thin warm-gold edge. Two or three tiny warm-gold spark accents maximum.
Composition: single compact iconic silhouette, talisman dominates at roughly70percent height, centered in a SQUARE canvas with at least9percent clear transparent margin on every side. Match the accepted logo's precise jade green/celadon, warm ivory, cinnabar and fine warm-gold palette; same elegant HD2D hand-painted brush texture and soft dimensional paint shading. Cute and adventurous, not dark or scary. No outer app tile, no badge shield, no enclosing circle or frame, no rectangular panel.
REMOVE / OMIT every Chinese and Latin letter, all five large title glyphs, background color, background glow rectangle, characters, creatures, weapons, scenery and floor. This is the small symbol that belongs to the accepted title logo, not a second wordmark or a contact sheet. Real transparent RGBA background and clear holes inside loop/cord/cloud; no checkerboard backdrop or ground shadow. Return only ONE complete emblem at the highest native square resolution available, no size labels or captions.
